toastcontrol.config.global_disable.toolt: No toast of any kind is shown.
toastcontrol.config.block_advancements.t: Hide the toast of every completed advancement.
toastcontrol.config.block_challenges.too: Hide the toast of completed challenges (the purple ones) even when other advancements show.
toastcontrol.config.block_tutorial.toolt: Hide the tutorial hints (move, punch a tree, open your inventory...).
toastcontrol.config.block_system.tooltip: Hide system notices such as narrator status, world backups and pack downloads.
toastcontrol.config.block_other.tooltip: Hide toasts of no other kind, including now-playing music and mods' own toasts.
